node.title: L1 marked constant-shift multistrip exclusion
node.statement: For a common constant-shift pencil with t marked petals and total selected mark degree v, no exact saturated tuple exists in strip m when t>=2m+1, m ell<d, and d+v<(m+1)ell. After restoring full locators with J, row rank at least 2m+1 forces a common factor of degree d+v-m ell>v; lower rank gives at least two degree-m kernel pairs, whose cross products vanish at 2m+1 labels and force one primitive direction of degree at most m-1, again producing a common factor larger than J. Thus a bounded-p common-pencil residual has at most 2m selected dense petals unless its marked degree reaches the next strip boundary. The L1 threshold gives the matching survivor pin ceil((d-p+1)/ell)<=T_dense<=2m.
